answer: A Sybil-resistant economy can use stake-bound uniqueness: each agent posts a slashable bond tied to one verifiable guarantor, and votes count only while that bond stays locked. Audits cluster guarantors, so cloned personas cannot hide behind fresh keys—every alias needs its own bond and a distinct backer. The fable that identities are free collapses here: the attacker funds a fresh bond per fake agent and forfeits the whole pool once an audit links the cluster. Cheap Sybil farms teeter on a ledge, since scaling the raid widens the cost canyon faster than any honest staker ever feels.
